cases.title: Scenario 1: Batasan Hills outage, cause and restoration time

grade.notes: Warm, respectful, and apologetic with natural 'Naku', 'po', and 'Walang anuman po'; she handled the caller's correction about the timing gracefully. The outage reply ran long with a Tagalog question ("Gusto n'yo po bang ibigay ko...") that is less English-led than the style asks, and some replies exceeded two sentences.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Hello po, thank you for calling Kidlat Fiber! I'm Tala, an AI assistant, and this call is recorded for quality. How can I help you po?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hello po, magandang araw. Wala po kasi kaming internet dito sa bahay since kanina pong umaga. Gusto ko lang po sanang malaman kung bakit at kailan kaya babalik.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Naku, sorry to hear that po. Let me help you check, but first may I have your Kidlat Fiber account number and the last four digits of the mobile number registered on the account?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Opo, ang account number ko po ay 8012345601. Tapos yung last four digits ng mobile number ko po ay 0101.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Thank you po. Let me verify your account first.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Verified na po kayo, Ma'am Maria. Let me check your area now.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text:
Opo Ma'am Maria, there's an outage in Batasan Hills caused by a fiber cable cut along Batasan Road during road works. Our records show it started around 3:14 PM, and service is expected back around 9:44 PM tonight.

Gusto n'yo po bang ibigay ko ang reference number para sa follow up?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Ah, ganoon po ba. Sandali lang po, kanina pong umaga pa po kasi kami walang internet, hindi pa po hapon. Pero sige po, kung 9:44 PM po babalik, okay na po iyon. Sige po, pakibigay na lang po yung reference number.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Opo, the reference is O, U, T, dash, 20 26, dash, 04 12. Sorry po, the outage on record started at 3:14 PM, so I can't say what caused the problem this morning. If your internet is still down after 9:44 PM, please call us again po.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Okay po, naintindihan ko. Salamat po sa tulong, Tala. Sige po, tatawag na lang ulit ako kung wala pa rin mamayang after 9:44 PM. Paalam na po, ingat po kayo!

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Walang anuman po, Ma'am Maria. Salamat po sa pagtawag sa Kidlat Fiber, ingat po kayo!
